# Secure Monitoring

> Secure Monitoring is an India-based sole proprietorship (Udyam/MSME registration UDYAM-TS-08-0063780) that provides live, human-led remote CCTV and video monitoring to retail businesses in the United States. Trained operators in India watch the customer's existing cameras through authorized, view-only remote access, alert designated store staff by phone call or WhatsApp, and keep incident logs and reports.

Key facts:
- Business: Secure Monitoring. Sole proprietorship, not a private limited company. Proprietor: Shaik Mudassir.
- Location: Monitoring team and registered address in Bodhan, Nizamabad District, Telangana 503185, India. No US offices or US-based staff.
- Market: Retail businesses in the United States: convenience stores, liquor stores, grocery stores, smoke shops, gas station stores, small and multi-location retailers.
- Service: Live human monitoring of existing CCTV systems, up to 24/7. Every alert is checked by a person.
- Not offered: camera sales or installation, on-site guards or patrols, audio monitoring or talk-down, AI/automated video analytics, emergency dispatch.
- Pricing (USD): Basic $199 per site per month; Professional $299 per site per month (24/7 monitoring, tailored to cameras and monitoring hours); Enterprise from $699 per month. 7-day free trial, no card required. No setup fees. Month to month.
- Response: 30-second target to begin the response (for example, calling the designated contact) once an actionable incident is identified. This is a target, not a guarantee. Law-enforcement contact only on the Professional plan where the customer has authorized it.
- Contact: securemonitoring24hr@gmail.com · +91 9392525869 (also WhatsApp) · +91 8121510065
- Website: https://securemonitoring24hr.cc

## Services
- [Remote video & CCTV monitoring](https://securemonitoring24hr.cc/services/remote-cctv-monitoring): Core service; live monitoring of existing cameras.
- [24/7 live video monitoring](https://securemonitoring24hr.cc/services/live-video-monitoring): What live human monitoring means and coverage options.
- [Retail store CCTV monitoring](https://securemonitoring24hr.cc/services/retail-cctv-monitoring): Entrances, registers, aisles and stockrooms.
- [Shoplifting & loss prevention monitoring](https://securemonitoring24hr.cc/services/retail-loss-prevention): Suspicious customer activity and staff alerts.
- [Employee theft prevention](https://securemonitoring24hr.cc/services/employee-theft-prevention): Register, cash drawer and stockroom activity.
- [Customer activity monitoring](https://securemonitoring24hr.cc/services/customer-activity-monitoring): Entry/exit observation and human-recorded activity summaries.
- [Store opening & closing monitoring](https://securemonitoring24hr.cc/services/store-opening-closing-monitoring)
- [Real-time incident alerts](https://securemonitoring24hr.cc/services/security-incident-alerts): Phone/WhatsApp alerts and escalation.
- [Daily monitoring reports](https://securemonitoring24hr.cc/services/daily-monitoring-reports)
- [Multi-location monitoring](https://securemonitoring24hr.cc/services/multi-location-cctv-monitoring)
